title: Gary Sheffield 1989 Topps Future Star Rookie #343 Milwaukee Brewers RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1989 Topps Future Star Rookie #343 trading card featuring Gary Sheffield of the Milwaukee Brewers. This original MLB baseball card is made of card stock with a 20 Pt. thickness and is part of the base variety set. The card showcases Sheffield's rookie season and is a collectible item for fans of the sport and the player. It is a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection, particularly for those interested in baseball history and notable players like Sheffield.
